seedCase.title: Xbox Console — refund not received after cancellation
seedCase.issueDescription: Customer cancelled an Xbox subscription and requested a refund; refund not reflected after 5 business days.
seedCase.symptomText: Refund not visible on original payment method; Order History shows 'Refunded'.
seedCase.causeText: Payment provider settlement delay compounded by a stale order-status cache.

relatedCases.title: Xbox refund delayed beyond 5 days
relatedCases.resolutionText: Confirmed order status 'Refunded' in Order History, then re-triggered the refund from the billing admin tool; funds settled within 24h. Advised customer of the 3–5 day provider window.
relatedCases.causeText: Provider settlement window; no product defect.

relatedCases.title: Refund not received — Xbox subscription cancellation
relatedCases.resolutionText: Verified payment method matched the original order; forced a refund status refresh; customer confirmed receipt next day.

relatedCases.title: Xbox billing — refund inquiry
relatedCases.resolutionText: Explained settlement timeline; no action needed — refund settled on day 4.
